g.text: tag pipeline: tag_q[s] = tag_d delayed s cycles (only the valid bit [8] is reset)
controls decoded from the tag stages (pd_s = ~tag_q[s][5]: even conv column)
rb_rd: fetch on odd conv rows (f+3); rb_wr: park on even rows except row 28 (f+4)
